result.summary: Found 3 layout issues: clipped restaurant titles, bottom card obscured by navigation, and cut-off filter chip at screen edge.

issues.description: Restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' appears rendered as 'Tokumaru Ramer' with the final character clipped at the edge, and 'Trattoria Piccolo' in Fastest near you is cut to 'Trattoria Piccol' without ellipsis
issues.suggestion: Fix text container width, padding and truncation so names are not clipped mid-character; use ellipsis for overflow and allow full name to be seen on scroll

issues.description: Bottom Popular card pizza image is abruptly cut off by the bottom tab bar with no spacing, hiding its name, delivery time and rating details
issues.suggestion: Add bottom scroll padding above the tab bar so the full card including text details is visible and not obscured

issues.description: Horizontal filter row shows a partially cut category chip at the far right screen edge, indicating missing end padding in the scroll container
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal end padding to the scrollable filter and carousel rows so partial cut-off does not look like a rendering error
